chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from ʿAli ibn al-Rayyan, who said:
I wrote to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man whose father called him to accept his bequest. Does he have the right to refrain from accepting his father’s bequest?
So he عليه السلام wrote in reply: “He does not have the right to refuse.”

key_terms.قَبُولِ وَصِيَّتِهِ: acceptance of the bequest or will

ai.seo_question: Can a son refuse to accept his father’s bequest?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a son being asked by his father to accept execution of his bequest. The Imam عليه السلام states that he does not have the right to refuse, indicating the binding force of this familial and legal responsibility in this case.
